caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded jug with a narrow, ridged neck and a small brown stopper at the top. The jug is colored in muted tan and light brown tones, with subtle shading to show its curved surface. Prominently featured on the front side of the jug is a dark blue illustration of a bird perched on a leafy branch, also rendered in shades of blue. The blue design shows the bird in profile facing to the right, with detailed feathers and leaves. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset image showing the jug from a different angle, revealing a handle attached near the top of the neck, and also including the same blue bird motif. The background is plain and beige, emphasizing the jug and its decoration.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
